04-bee-swarm-census.visual_critic_note: Intentional colorblind-safe palette, clear typographic hierarchy, and smart swarm+boxplot pairing earn a 7, but the percentile labels visibly overlap the subtitle text and the rightmost callout ('Sam Q.') is clipped at the SVG edge.
04-bee-swarm-census.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale correctly matches log-normal data distribution, fixed-radius dots avoid area-encoding deception, box plot statistics are data-derived and correctly computed, no baseline violation for a dot/swarm chart; minor robustness gap from hardcoded domain [14000,550000] instead of d3.extent, and no key functions in the data join (acceptable for a static render).
04-bee-swarm-census.stress_test_note: Fully static simulation (pre-computed, no live forces), pointer-event-unified tooltips with no DOM mutation on move, zero transitions, no cross-view dispatch, and no brush/zoom—none of the five interaction failure modes apply; only minor issue is offsetWidth read on every pointermove causing a micro-reflow.
04-bee-swarm-census.cognitive_load_note: 4-color Tol palette, pre-computed swarm, and a complementary box plot keep cognitive load low; the 5 leader-line callouts cluster and slightly overlap in the high-income tail but don't break readability.
